title: Add supporting characters
description: Good for adding rivals, allies, pressure sources or key relationship characters. AI suggests candidates from the existing cast.

fields.modeHint: AI decides by default; only pin it manually when you know exactly which kind of character to add.
fields.referenceHint: Can be left blank; if blank, AI decides who to build around.
fields.extraPlaceholder: e.g. add an ordinary person who pressures the protagonist but isn't fully a villain; or an old acquaintance tied to the mother's storyline.

options.modeAuto: AI decides what type is needed
options.modeLinked: Derive a relationship character from an existing one

status.noCharacters: There are no characters yet, so relationship-based additions aren't possible. Create core characters first or choose a standalone addition.
status.applyFailed: Failed to apply the supporting character.
